dataList.title:
Giant
巨人
dataList.content: AAAAAHHHHH! 啊啊啊啊啊！

In my hand is a link of a chain, broken off when I ended the life of the thing I called Mother.
我的手中，握着终结名为妈妈这一存在的生命时，所断裂掉落的一块锁链碎片。

This is a symbol.
这是象征。

A symbol that protects me and allows me to remain on my feet.
保护我，让我能够站立的象征。

People may capture me in their gaze as they please, but with these chains, I may remain standing, bound in place.
即便人们肆意地将我纳入视线之中，我也依旧能在束缚之中站立下去。

If I choose to exist by binding myself...
若是我能在束缚之中存在下去……

Then I may endure this terrifying, dizzying world...
即便这个世界令人恐惧、令人眩晕到反胃感不断上涌……

... through all the nausea that comes with it.
我也能忍耐下去。

Surrounded by the silence of the living room, I sat absentmindedly in a patch of sunlight peering through a gap in the windowsill.
我在寂静的客厅里坐了一会，呆望着窗缝间涌入的阳光。

The vacuum of what was once there. The warm chill circulating the air. The sun.
变得空荡的地方。飘浮在空中的温暖冷意。太阳。

I come to a stop, bound in place.
紧接着，我被束缚住，停下了。

To remain bound and still... that was the burden you were meant to bear.
于束缚之中停止……乃是汝应当承受的业。

Do you realize... what you are about to do?
如今……汝可知晓自身将要做些什么？

Departing from the Grand Magasin's appointed ending will unleash a chain of events that can neither be predicted nor managed. Are you aware of what that future holds?
若是偏离百货店那已然定下的结局，恐怕会产生无法预测也无法应对的事情吧。汝有考虑过此种未来吗？

I do not. Nevertheless, I will leave this place.
不知道。但我会离开这里。

... How irresponsible.
……如此不负责任。

I do not want the Manager and the others to remain trapped here.
我不希望执行经理与其他人被一直困在这里。

The Chaplain grows steadily more weary and decrepit.
牧师逐渐衰老下去。

It seems that even he cannot endure the eternity he had imposed upon this place.
对牧师而言，忍受他于此处赋予的永恒时间，也在逐渐成为一种负担。

... Time flowed... and there was nothing to do but endure it.
对于时间……除了忍耐以外，没有别的答案。

If Grand Magasin Sisyphe collapses, every inhuman monstrosity contained in here will spill out into the streets. Yes, the monsters you may know as Mannequins here—and as Distortions outside—will be let loose in N Corp., free to wreak havoc.
若是西西弗百货如此崩塌，此处所有不具人形的存在都将去往都市。而此处称作人台、外界称作扭曲的怪物们，将会在N公司中肆意破坏。

This department store... must have only two endings.
这家百货店……仅能拥有两个结局。

Why must it?
为什么必须如此？

Because human beings... are capable of suppressing their desires.
因为人类……乃是可以压抑欲望的存在……

Human beings do not eat one another simply because they are hungry, or burn down a house just because they are consumed by anger.
不会因腹中饥饿便去食人，不会因怒火中烧便去烧毁房屋。

Beasts fall upon their food and gorge. Humans sit at the table, master the hunger clawing inside them, and raise a fork to their mouths. That restraint is the mark of humanity—not tearing into whatever is within reach and shoveling it into their ravenous gullets!
野兽仅会摄取，而人类则会用餐。压抑欲望，于餐桌前就座，使用餐具……这才是人性。而非以手抓取进食！

And that... is what makes the Sisyphe System the most "human" place in the City.
因此……西西弗系统正是都市中最为人类的场所。

If barbarism is allowed to return... N Corp. will not hesitate to dive into conflicts against the other Wings. There will be war.
若是野蛮再度到来……N公司定会与其他翼爆发战争。

Its advocates will crack people's heads open and scrape out their experiences raw... Is that the future you want?
他们会破开人类的头颅，从中直接挖出经验……汝是希望如此的未来吗？

I cannot... expend any more effort on the sinful one. I must withdraw here... for the continued existence of the Grand Magasin... the Sisyphe System.
不能再对……有罪之人倾注气力了。为了百货店……西西弗系统的存续……吾该就此退场了。

By the time you realize you chose wrong, it will be too late. You will have plenty of time for regrets when surrounded by the ruins of your error...
汝很快便会意识到此般选择乃是错误的，但为时已晚。即便汝于那时后悔，一切也早已结束了吧……

... You are correct.
……如你所言。

I may regret it someday. What I considered the best choice at the time may later prove to have been the worst. My decision may be wrong. All meaning is subject to change, after all.
我或许某天会后悔，那时以为是最好的选择可能会在日后变成最坏的。我的决定可能出错。毕竟一切意义本就会改变。

However...
……然而。

I want to try bearing the responsibility for my own judgments.
我想去承担。我作出决定后，属于我的责任。

Once more, Meursault opened the door.
默尔索再次打开了门。

The Grand Magasin... must be eternally preserved... This department store... must be sustained...
百货店……必须被保存……百货店……必须被……维持……

<Do you really mean it?>
<你真的打算承担吗？>

I do, Manager.
是的，经理。

<What made you feel that way?>
<为什么会那么想呢？>

I do not yet know what the reason is,
我尚不完全清楚其理由。

But I know it is here.
但理由确实存在于此。
